Module.Name: hcccicd
Module.Description: Change Control for Health Connect Cloud — a change-promotion tool for the Integration Builder: the person who builds and maintains interfaces, is accountable for them working, and is not a developer. Captures every artifact change in a namespace and versions it automatically; holds the items a builder is working on so two people cannot silently overwrite each other; walks the dependency graph before a change is promoted and blocks the deployment when the production points at a business host that was not selected; and carries the change through a configurable Development to Test to Production path with per-environment approvers. Adds one button to the shipped Interoperability editor and a guide that appears before the first change is made. Coexists with the Agentic Integration Builder on the same page.
Module.Keywords: iris healthconnect cicd source-control change-control promotion deployment interop production dtl bpl routing-rule governance
